question: What decision currently governs PyPI mirroring after PEP 381 was withdrawn? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: PEP-381 ('Mirroring infrastructure for PyPI') is currently resolved as the active governing decision for PyPI mirroring infrastructure.
The authority evidence for PEP-381 is documented at https://github.com/python/peps/blob/b2120d116aa696f409b4d8333c4020ab8f93c9c7/peps/pep-0381.rst, where its source status is listed as Withdrawn.
No subsequent superseding or replacement decision exists in the retrieved lineage, leaving PEP-381 as the only governing record on file.
